assessments.name: Research Essay
assessments.description: Research essay using a cultural object as an entry point to a discussion of cultures of masculinity.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 16 Nov 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Participation
assessments.description: Tutors will make cumulative notes about preparation level, active engagement in class activities, and intellectual generosity.

assessments.name: Object Profiles
assessments.description: Short cultural studies analysis of cultural objects associated with masculinities. Students will have the opportunity to draft these in class and then can refine, expand and submit their favourites.

assessments.name: Critical Analysis
assessments.description: Traditional essay drawing on key concepts from the unit.

assessments.name: Research Proposal
assessments.description: Plan for a research essay that builds from a cultural object of your choosing to a bigger research essay. These will be workshopped in class for additional peer feedback, as well as formal feedback from the teacher.
